smart-money-concepts.intro: Explore four visual guides to Smart Money Concepts covering the book's core framework, learning outcomes, key concepts and intended readers.

pins.title: Smart Money Concepts — Visual Summary
pins.description: A visual summary of Smart Money Concepts by Faramarz Kowsari, highlighting market structure, liquidity, displacement, Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps, setup logic and invalidation.
pins.alt_text: Visual summary infographic for Smart Money Concepts by Faramarz Kowsari covering market structure, liquidity, Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps, setups and invalidation.

pins.title: Smart Money Concepts — What You Will Learn
pins.description: A reader-focused visual guide to the practical skills and ideas covered in Smart Money Concepts, from structure and liquidity to evidence-based setup building and risk awareness.
pins.alt_text: What You Will Learn infographic for Smart Money Concepts by Faramarz Kowsari, focused on structure, liquidity, evidence-based trade setups and risk-aware chart reading.

pins.title: Smart Money Concepts — Key Concepts
pins.description: A visual map of the book's central concepts, including market structure, liquidity, displacement, Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps, premium and discount, invalidation and risk management.
pins.alt_text: Key Concepts infographic for Smart Money Concepts by Faramarz Kowsari showing market structure, liquidity, displacement, Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps, premium and discount, invalidation and risk management.

pins.title: Smart Money Concepts — Who This Book Is For
pins.description: A visual guide to the readers who can benefit from Smart Money Concepts, especially traders seeking a practical, testable and evidence-conscious SMC framework.
pins.alt_text: Who This Book Is For infographic for Smart Money Concepts by Faramarz Kowsari, designed for traders learning or refining an evidence-conscious Smart Money Concepts framework.
